label: Order
caption: MERRICK B. GARLAND, ATTORNEY GENERAL, ET AL. V. BLACKHAWK MANUFACTURING GROUP, INC., ET AL.
text: UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicants, IT IS ORDERED that the September 14, 2023 order of the United States District Court for the Northern District of Texas, case No. 4:22-cv-691, is hereby administratively stayed until 5 p.m. (EDT) on Monday, October 16, 2023. It is further ordered that any response to the application be filed on or before Wednesday, October 11, 2023, by 5 p.m. (EDT).
